messages:
maria: @audit_team auditor asked for a scenario-based walkthrough mapping a simulated lateral-movement incident to SOC2 control artifacts. Can we run a short demo tomorrow? :wave:

oliver: happy to. what's the scope? logs, KMS access, RBAC changes, and incident timeline?

maria: yes — they want to see end-to-end: detection alert -> triage notes -> SIEM export -> role change proof -> KMS key access history -> artifact bundle. Prefer sample timeline and exact queries we ran.

james: I'll draft the timeline. Quick note: KMS audit logs are in cloud-keys-prod -> use query 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign"' for signing ops in Stackdriver.

maria: gah internal naming is GCP-specific, auditors prefer generic. Can we show both: cloud provider query + exported CSV snapshot? Also show RBAC diffs (kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml) with git commit that changed it.

oliver: example commands I used in past:
```
# export rolebinding snapshot
kubectl get rolebinding -n prod app-service -o yaml > /tmp/rb-app-service-2026-03-01.yaml
# GCP KMS log query
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.methodName:"KeyManagementService"' --project=prod-keys --format=json > kms-logs.json
```

aud it_bot: auditor_request_12345 created by @external_auditor on 2026-03-01T14:12Z. Requested artifacts: SIEM export, KMS key history, RBAC change diff, incident postmortem link.

maria: I'll assemble a minimal evidence bundle. Plan:
1) Timeline.md (detection -> containment -> recovery)
2) SIEM_export.csv (alerts 2026-02-28 22:10 - 2026-03-01 02:00)
3) KMS_access_history.json (exported from logging)
4) RBAC_diff.patch (git diff between commits abc123..def456)
5) Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-182

james: For RBAC proof, add commit SHAs and PR link, and screenshot of console showing role binding change with approver. Small snippet:
```
commit def456
Author: security-eng <security@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01 13:05:22 -0700
    fix: restrict app-service rolebinding to svc-account
```

oliver: auditors sometimes ask for chain-of-custody. We should include export checksum and signed manifest. I'll generate sha256 sums and sign with our ops key (key id: ops-2024).

maria: ok next actions:
- @james assemble timeline + RBAC diff by EOD
- @oliver export KMS logs and checksums by EOD
- @maria produce SIEM export and upload bundle to secure share

james: ack. will ping when ready :white_check_mark:

oliver: ack. starting export now :arrow_down_small:

maria: FYI auditor also asked about retention policy for KMS logs and if we have a rotation schedule. @security-eng can you confirm retention? :eyes:

security-eng: KMS audit logs retained 2 years in central logging. Key rotation schedule: yearly for symmetric keys, rotation notes in https://redwood.internal/security/kms-rotation. Will attach the policy doc.

maria: perfect. I'll reference that in the artifact manifest. Any objections to delivering a redacted bundle for privacy? we will mask PII and internal IPs.

aud it_bot: evidence_bundle_12345 uploaded to secure-share by @maria at 2026-03-01T18:22Z

external_auditor: thanks for quick turnaround. Can you also include the playbooks used during triage? a short runbook is fine.

maria: will include the triage playbook (triage-runbook.md) and a short video screencap of running the kubectl commands (optional) — estimated tomorrow morning.

james: done with RBAC diff, pushed to PR https://redwood.internal/pull/4567 and attached patch to bundle.

oliver: KMS logs exported and checksum attached: sha256: 9f8b7c3a5d2e4b1c6a9f0d3e2b4c5a6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2

maria: uploading final manifest now. Closing thread after auditor ack.

external_auditor: received bundle and manifest. Thank you. We'll review and follow up if needed. :thumbsup:
